days.reason: The day is dedicated to John the Baptist as the forerunner. The text contains his main message of repentance, the prophecy of 'a voice in the wilderness' (v. 3), the warning to the Pharisees, and the promise of the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire (vv. 11-12). This is the central text for this Sunday.

The day marks the transition into Lent and Jesus' first public act: his baptism. The text describes Jesus' baptism, the descent of the Spirit, and the voice from the Father, which marks the beginning of Jesus' public ministry and preparation for his 40 days in the wilderness (read on the First Sunday of Lent).
